env: Bright 3D animated dental clinic for kids: glossy blue square wall tiles, white tiled floor, big chrome dentist chair, soft blue and white lighting, clean glossy cartoon render, 16:9, no text.
persona: Sharky: chubby friendly grey-blue cartoon shark, big white eyes, huge mouth of triangular white teeth, round belly. Tino and Tilly: two small white cartoon tooth mascots with big eyes, stubby arms and legs, cheerful expressions.

shots.prompt: Wide establishing shot of the bright blue-tiled dental clinic, Sharky the chubby cartoon shark sitting in the big chrome dentist chair with mouth wide open, Tino and Tilly standing beside the chair waving at the camera.
Extreme close-up of the shark's open mouth: two rows of big triangular teeth with breakfast cereal, crumbs and a piece of banana stuck between them, gross but colourful and funny.
Tino the tooth mascot holding both cheeks with wide shocked eyes, mouth open in a comical 'oh no', standing on the dentist chair armrest.
Tilly the tooth mascot proudly holding up an oversized yellow toothbrush twice her own height, big grin, blue tiled clinic behind.
Close-up: the giant yellow toothbrush pressed against the shark's front teeth, brown crumbs and bits of food flying outward in motion, shiny white enamel appearing where it has scrubbed.
The shark's huge mouth squeezed shut in a happy grin, white and blue minty foam bubbling between the teeth, eyes half closed in bliss.
Tino the tooth mascot holding a blue hose nozzle, a thick clear water stream jetting into the shark's open mouth, droplets sparkling.
Extreme close-up of the shark's front teeth now perfectly clean and glossy white, reflecting the clinic lights, tiny sparkle highlights.
Macro close-up of two front teeth stained bright orange with juice, sticky orange droplets on the enamel, funny rather than gross.
Tilly the tooth mascot holding up a small round-headed electric brush with a soft pink head, cheerful proud face.
Close-up of the round brush spinning in circles on the orange-stained tooth, orange foam swirling in a spiral, motion blur.
A clear water stream washing the orange foam off the teeth, orange bubbles sliding down and away.
Extreme close-up of the two front teeth, now sparkling white again, a single water droplet falling from a tooth tip.
Macro close-up: a pink sticky candy chewed onto a back molar, stretching in a sticky string, with a tiny fly-free cartoon look.
Tino the tooth mascot holding a long thin white floss loop stretched between his two stubby hands.
Close-up of the floss sliding in and out between two back teeth, pink candy being pulled out in a sticky thread.
The pink candy chunk pops free and flies out of frame, the shark's eye blinking in surprise, clean gap between the teeth.
Macro close-up of a small green broccoli floret wedged tightly between two back teeth, cartoon-style.
Tino and Tilly standing side by side both holding small brushes up in the air, determined cheerful faces.
Close-up of two small brushes wiggling together against the trapped broccoli, green bits loosening, bubbles.
The broccoli floret flies out of the frame with a little spray of water, the gap between the teeth now clean.
A giant yellow toothbrush lowered into frame filling most of the picture, held by both tooth mascots, the shark's mouth open wide below.
Extreme close-up: the giant brush scrubbing across the whole row of teeth, thick white minty foam covering everything, sparkling bubbles.
A curtain of clear water rinsing the foam away, the whole row of teeth gleaming wet and white, light refracting.
Sharky the chubby cartoon shark laughing with a huge open smile, every tooth perfectly white and sparkling, Tino and Tilly cheering on the chair.
Final shot: Sharky in the dentist chair with Tino and Tilly on either side, all three waving at the camera with big smiles, bright blue clinic.

shots.overlay: Brush, brush, brush! Up and down!
shots.prompt: Wide shot of the bright blue-tiled dental clinic: the chubby cartoon shark sits in the dentist chair brushing his own teeth with a giant yellow brush while the two small white tooth mascots brush their own tiny teeth beside him, all three brushing in rhythm.
Overhead top-down macro view looking straight into the shark's open mouth, a big round brush spinning in circles on the molars, white foam swirling in a spiral, no characters.
The two small white tooth mascots standing side by side facing the camera, each holding a brush up like a microphone, big happy open mouths as if singing.

shots.overlay: Sharky smiles a great big smile!
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of the chubby cartoon shark's face with a huge open happy smile, all teeth sparkling white, eyes squinting with joy.

shots.overlay: Left side, right side, front and back!
shots.prompt: Fun shot inside the shark's open mouth: two tooth mascots standing on the lower teeth, one brushing the left side, the other brushing the right side, foam everywhere.

shots.overlay: Shh, shh, shh! Spit it out!
shots.prompt: The shark leaning over a white ceramic sink spitting out minty white foam, the two tooth mascots watching proudly beside the sink.
Close-up of clear water splashing in the white sink, foam washing away down the drain, sparkling water droplets in the air.
All three characters dancing together in the middle of the blue-tiled clinic, the shark wiggling with a brush in his fin, the two tooth mascots jumping with brushes up.

shots.overlay: Brush, brush, brush! See you soon!
shots.prompt: Warm final shot: the shark and the two tooth mascots giving each other a high five in front of the dentist chair, all smiling at the camera, bright blue clinic.
